targetText: When Vassilissa met a detachment on the street, going to war in full military array, she always had to turn away.
explanation: Vassilissa's early Bolshevik consciousness rejects imperialist war and capitalist slaughter in favor of working-class internationalism.

targetText: She was flat-chested, and wore a shirtwaist and a wornout leather belt. She was not pretty. But her eyes were beautiful: brown, friendly, observant.
explanation: Introducing Vassilissa as a working-class revolutionary woman whose beauty lies in her sharp intellect and dedication rather than bourgeois fashion standards.
